info.title: Main - Floriday Suppliers API
info.description:
﻿Every endpoint requires at least the `role:app` scope and the header `X-Api-Key` populated with your given API-key. Most endpoints also require an additional scope which is listed in their descriptions.

- 🗝 [Authorization server (staging)](https://idm.staging.floriday.io/oauth2/ausmw6b47z1BnlHkw0h7/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server)
- 🗝 [Authorization server (live)](https://idm.floriday.io/oauth2/aus3testdcf2vyfs70i7/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server)
- 📚 [Documentation](https://developer.floriday.io/docs/welcome)
- ▶ [Coding screencast: getting started (NL)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fdqzP7_Y_s8)

---

_The current state of this version 2026v1 is **Main**._
* This version will be main after April 2026.
* This version will be deprecated after October 2026.
* This version will be removed after April 2027.

---

🔗 2025v2: [Customers API](https://api.staging.floriday.io/customers-api-2025v2/swagger/index.html) | [Suppliers API](https://api.staging.floriday.io/suppliers-api-2025v2/swagger/index.html)
🔗 2026v1: [Customers API](https://api.staging.floriday.io/customers-api-2026v1/swagger/index.html) | [Suppliers API](https://api.staging.floriday.io/suppliers-api-2026v1/swagger/index.html)
🔗 2026v2: [Customers API](https://api.staging.floriday.io/customers-api-2026v2/swagger/index.html) | [Suppliers API](https://api.staging.floriday.io/suppliers-api-2026v2/swagger/index.html)
